summary: Narrow kerb with houses 10 m away, no parked cars and steep grade.
reasons: No cars parked on this side

best_section.where: West kerb of Clarence Road, south of the side street junction

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses at 10 m and 11 m on the same side, more within 18 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb beside a narrow lane with tree and verge strip; no visible parked cars on this side.
drivers.traffic: Through road linking suburbs; moving traffic past the kerb.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on this side and a no stopping sign, so a van would stand out.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign at the kerb
sun_shade: Trees on the west side shade it in the afternoon; open to morning sun from the east.
